integrity: The claim was reconstructed from the published single-axis formulas, checked against the full primary preprint and a later full analytic treatment, and replayed with the bundled verifier. Numerical root values are supplementary to the analytic uniqueness proof.
scientific_limitations: Counterexample family only; no global classification of the optimal DM direction. The single-axis concurrence formulas are prior work, and a later unnoticed correction remains a literature risk.
title: Third-axis obstruction to pairwise DM-direction dominance in the XYZ dimer
